_comment: Upstream i100 default + DP guide mode (soft steering). The mode is resolved last (dp_defaults.resolve_route_mode), so it turns off the i100 clinic and the i085 macro switches and selects the weighted scheduler, because a route filter is a scheduler hook. Explicit --clinic / --scheduler / --root-policies here would be rejected instead.
resource_note: User-specified 6-core topology (CPUs 2,4,6,8,10,12), 6 workers x dop 1, 1 GiB per worker; same resource envelope as tools/solver_configs/sts-6core-strict-then-search.json
